title: mimid: carry and skip extension dictionaries in UpdateRequest, UpdateRoomResponse, KeyMaterialRequest and ClientKeyMaterial
description: mimi-protocol codecs: decode the new extensions fields (per the draft PR), keep unknown entries skippable, encode empty by default. Version-gate or behind a setting until the WG adopts it, since it changes -07 wire. Tests: round-trip, unknown entries ignored, -07 peers unaffected.
notes:
3453c80: codec half done (WireProfile Draft07/Extensions190; encode/decode with extensions beside the message; 1365 tests pass). Server wiring waits on PR #220's TBS question: a provider can't translate a client-signed KeyMaterialRequest between profiles.
3e19472: request extensions moved after the signature (PR #220 updated, 18570b5); [wire_profiles] config; Hub::update and PeerClient::update speak the peer's profile. Remaining: key-material request/response wiring (follower/relay/JMAP/hub key_material).
